evidence.headline: Today we're launching the Data Marketplace for Agents: 100+ providers that agents and developers can find and pay for per call.
evidence.idea: An agent needs a little data from a lot of places, and it shouldn't have to buy three subscriptions to make two requests.
bullets: About 90% of our usage already comes from customers using five or more providers, including @DustHQ, @ZenskarHQ and @foundeers.
evidence.summary: Providers list once, and agents find what they need and pay per call from one balance, over MCP, CLI or API.
evidence.practice_takeaway: If you or your agents need data, get started at https://orthogonal.com.

wrong_number_context.why: Source shows only some listings; 'start at' and 'reach' imply the whole catalog's price range.
